requirements.text: Keep this a reusable knowledge brief, not campaign, offer, SKU or claim approval. Supplied positioning establishes strategic intent; the entire Visual World Guide remains draft, including mandatory, approved and locked labels.

Follow the positioning's attentive, insightful, supportive and warm personality. Communicate clearly without overpromising, overselling, fear-mongering, lifestyle shaming or dramatic transformation promises.

Use current exact-SKU official evidence for product identity and facts. Strategy, collection copy, reference furniture and technical illustrations do not approve efficacy, quantified performance, mechanisms or compatibility.

Retain unresolved identity and portfolio conflicts. Confirm production logo, typography, tagline lockup and adopted naming before execution; do not reconstruct artwork from slides or implement proposed range migrations.

Treat interior references and derived research as advisory, not approved product imagery or mandatory styling. Maintain Duroflex-only scope; neither third-party examples nor another workspace's guidance supplies this brand's identity.

preferences.text: Strategic interpretation: express Motivating Reset through pause, connection and renewed participation, not permanent inactivity. Reading, conversation, hobbies and everyday readiness are proposed narratives, not demonstrated product outcomes.

Draft direction: contemporary, tactile, climate-aware domestic architecture. Proposed application: establish openings, product footprint, storage, activity zones and usable circulation before décor; borrow spatial relationships rather than reference furniture.

Draft palette proposal, not approved swatches: bone, sand, taupe and stone with sage, olive, clay, wine, midnight blue or soft sky. Build tonal separation around unchanged product colour rather than making every scene beige.

Observed recognition cue: official imagery uses a red symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX. Restrained environmental red is a draft preference only; contradictory red-prop examples and prohibitions remain unresolved. No exact colour values are established.

Proposed lighting and camera approach: opening-led illumination, credible practical lamps and readable contact shadows. Use frontal views for silhouette, three-quarter views for depth and close views for contact. Develop morning, day and evening references separately; repeated draft daylight scenes do not establish evening lighting.

Draft people direction: natural supported actions, companionship and relaxed tactile homewear rather than presenter poses. Proposed checks include anatomy, compression, occlusion and garment tension. Casting remains open; do not infer nationality or customer beliefs from appearance.

Proposed sleep treatments: everyday bedrooms with visible mattress edges and branding; Airboost may use restrained cool supporting tones and separately verified technical views; Duropedic may use domestic warmth without medical theatre. Beds and smart sleep need a clearly identified hero and verified functional combination.

Proposed seating treatments: connected social lounges for sofas and sheltered reading corners for recliners. Show motion only in documented configurations with verified clearance; ports, power, rotation and rocking are model-specific, not category assumptions.

Proposed accessories and device treatments: close, specific pillow contact and identifiable contours; warm functional domestic settings for documented massager use. Texture and resting poses explain appearance or use, not composition, cooling, alignment or therapeutic effects.

Draft planning prompts: Icon, Inhabited Hero, World and Intelligence shots, with later channel derivatives. These are not required deliverables. One clear focal message and ordered proof are useful draft preferences; the breathing-space percentage and scorecard are not approved specifications.

Dated public practice includes black-and-gold festive selling, red accents, dark technology imagery and varied domestic scenes. These coexist rather than define a permanent palette. Proposed application: keep commercial panels distinct from room photography and revalidate offers.

visualRules.value: Recorded client production boundary: preserve the selected product's actual colour, fabric appearance, construction, seams, labels, controls and branding, including older branding physically present. Adapt the environment, not product identity; reference furniture is not a substitute SKU.

Recorded client scene-integration boundary: no fake white patches, contrast fades, haze, blur masks or gradients inside photographs. Use genuine architectural copy space or a clearly separate graphic canvas. Draft gradient examples do not override this boundary.

preserve: Motivating Reset as supplied strategic essence, with attentive, insightful, supportive and warm communication—not a newly invented tagline.
Designed to De-Stress as the publicly announced philosophy, distinct from approval of a production lockup.
Duroflex's broader comfort scope alongside its sleep heritage; neither establishes product efficacy.
Authentic product identity and physical branding, with strategy, draft direction, public observation and proposals kept distinct.
The supplied brandbook's status and authority; this guide interprets evidence rather than replacing it.
explore: Proposal: compact connected homes and garden thresholds as starting points; filtered-light rooms, social lounges, reading corners and colour-led bedrooms as conditional alternatives.
Proposal: arrival, settling, connection and readiness stories that express reset without implying a proven product-caused transformation.
Proposal: tactile contrast, integrated greenery and useful domestic objects rather than uniform beige minimalism.
Proposal: category-specific light and activity within a shared domestic language, preserving exact product appearance.
Proposal: retail arrival, attentive consultation, semi-private trials and social zones, informed by positioning rather than decorative vignettes alone.
avoid: Promoting draft palettes, sans-serif instructions, character boards, shot classes, percentages or approval scores into mandatory rules.
Borrowing another brand's identity, copying complete third-party interiors or depicting reference furniture as Duroflex inventory.
Reconstructing logos, choosing exact fonts or hex codes from rendered slides, or silently resolving conflicting taglines.
Publishing Restore, Recharge, Oasis or Recalibrate as adopted architecture without confirmation.
Medical fear, pain or heat glows, invented cutaways, unsupported stress treatment, recovery, airflow or guarantee claims.
Selecting between 200K versus one-lakh-plus fibres, 4X versus 3X performance, or conflicting discounts without current SKU-specific approval.
Removing authentic product labels, recolouring upholstery, inventing mechanisms or concealing the feature supposedly being demonstrated.
Treating calm rooms, poses or texture as clinical proof; treating inaccessible social or advertising evidence as audience or performance insight.
unknowns: Final production logo vectors, typography, tagline lockup, colour specifications and identity governance remain unresolved.
Environmental red permissions conflict within the draft; product colour is not optional styling.
No selected SKU, variant, campaign objective, audience, desired action, placement, copy, offer or approved claim set is supplied.
Adoption and migration of proposed portfolio names are not established.
Dimensions, mechanism clearances, operating configurations and component compatibility require selected-product evidence where relevant.
Reference provenance, reuse permissions and casting approvals remain unconfirmed.
Draft shot-class and deliverable lists differ; the scorecard lists eight ten-point criteria but claims a total of 100.
Occupied massager and adjustable-bed sequences are comparatively thin; motion continuity, full social feeds and paid creative were not reviewed.
The 371-image coverage is attributed to supplied prior model research, not a new inspection here; rendered fonts and small embedded images have limitations.
guide.decisionSummary: Preserve Duroflex's sourced strategy, public philosophy and truthful product identity. Use the draft's warm domestic world as a qualified exploration framework, not an approved visual specification. Keep only the recorded product-integrity and scene-integration boundaries mandatory; resolve identity, portfolio, SKU and claim gaps before production.
